design.title: SYNQUE — Enterprise Social Media Command Center
design.reference: Apple Keynote dark + gold luxury accent

slides.title: SYNQUE
slides.task_brief: Cover slide. Center-aligned. Large 'SYNQUE' wordmark in gold gradient text (Playfair Display, 96px). Below it: 'Orchestrate Your Social' in white (Inter, 32px, weight 300). Below that: 'The Enterprise Command Center for Modern Social Teams' in muted gray (18px). Add a subtle gold accent pill at top that says 'PRODUCT OVERVIEW'. Bottom-left brand mark: 'SYNQUE'. Bottom-right: '01 / 15'. The slide should feel premium and cinematic — dark background with a subtle radial gold glow behind the wordmark. Speaker notes: Welcome the audience, introduce SYNQUE as the enterprise social media command center.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.task_brief:
Slide title: 'Social media is broken' (h1, 48px, white). Subtitle: 'Managing 7 platforms shouldn't feel like herding cats' (muted, 18px). Three glass cards in a row, each with an icon (use Material Icons), a bold headline, and 2-line description:
1. Icon: 'scatter_plot' (rose color). Title: 'Scattered Platforms'. Text: '7 platforms, 7 logins, 7 dashboards. Your team wastes hours switching context.'
2. Icon: 'gpp_bad' (rose color). Title: 'No Safety Net'. Text: 'Accounts get suspended overnight. No warnings, no protection, no recourse.'
3. Icon: 'analytics' (rose color). Title: 'Blind Spots'. Text: 'You can\'t see what competitors are doing. You can\'t measure what works.'
Bottom-right: '02 / 15'. Speaker notes: Frame the pain — teams juggle too many tools, accounts are at risk, and insights are missing.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'One flow. Every platform. Zero chaos.' (gold gradient text, 48px). Subtitle: 'SYNQUE brings your entire social media workflow into one calm, powerful interface.' Three glass cards with gold borders:
1. Icon: 'hub' (gold). Title: 'Unified Publishing'. Text: 'Compose once, publish to 7 platforms simultaneously. AI optimizes each caption per platform.'
2. Icon: 'auto_awesome' (gold). Title: 'AI-Powered Content'. Text: 'Generate platform-specific captions, hashtags, and content variations with a single click.'
3. Icon: 'shield' (gold). Title: 'Built-in Protection'. Text: 'Anti-suspension guards, banned-hashtag blocking, and smart cooldowns keep your accounts safe.'
Bottom-right: '03 / 15'. Speaker notes: Introduce the three pillars — unified publishing, AI content, and account safety.

slides.title: Key Features
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Everything you need. Nothing you don\'t.' (white, 36px). Subtitle: '24 modules. One workspace. Zero chaos.' (muted, 16px). 8 feature cards in a 4-column x 2-row grid. Each card: Material icon (gold), title (bold, 16px), 1-line description (muted, 13px):
1. 'edit_note' — AI Composer — 'Generate platform-specific captions'
2. 'calendar_month' — Content Calendar — 'Drag-and-drop scheduling'
3. 'inbox' — Unified Inbox — 'All comments in one place'
4. 'shield' — Account Safety — 'Anti-suspension protection'
5. 'groups' — Team Workflow — 'Roles, approvals, assignments'
6. 'bar_chart' — Analytics — 'Cross-platform insights'
7. 'campaign' — Campaigns — 'Track marketing campaigns'
8. 'visibility' — Competitor Tracking — 'Monitor the competition'
Bottom-right: '04 / 15'. Speaker notes: Highlight the breadth of features — 24 modules covering every social media need.

slides.title: Supported Platforms
slides.task_brief:
Title: '7 platforms. One click.' (gold text, 42px). Subtitle: 'Publish to every major social network from a single composer.' 7 platform cards in a row (use flex, evenly spaced). Each card: platform name (bold), short code (IG, FB, X, in, TT, YT, Th), and character limit (muted, 12px). Use colored top borders per platform:
1. Instagram — IG — 2,200 chars — border: #E1306C
2. Facebook — FB — 63,206 chars — border: #1877F2
3. X (Twitter) — X — 280 chars — border: #1DA1F2
4. LinkedIn — in — 3,000 chars — border: #0A66C2
5. TikTok — TT — 2,200 chars — border: #000
6. YouTube — YT — 5,000 chars — border: #FF0000
7. Threads — Th — 500 chars — border: #000
Below: a gold pill that says 'Post to all 7 in one click'. Bottom-right: '05 / 15'. Speaker notes: Emphasize that SYNQUE supports all 7 major platforms and you can cross-post to all simultaneously.

slides.title: Cross-Posting
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'One post. Seven platform-optimized variants.' (gold text, 36px). Subtitle: 'Write once. AI adapts the caption for each platform.' Create a visual flow: left side has a single 'One Post' card (gold border, icon: 'edit'). Center has an arrow/connector (use CSS border or Material icon 'arrow_forward'). Right side has 7 small cards stacked or in a grid, each showing a platform icon + a sample caption preview:
- Instagram: 'Loving the new collection! ✨ Shop now 👉 #fashion #newdrop'
- Facebook: 'Our new collection is here! Shop the full range on our website today.'
- X: 'New drop just landed. Shop now → #fashion'
- LinkedIn: 'Excited to announce our latest collection, designed for the modern professional.'
- TikTok: 'POV: you just saw the new drop 🔥 #fyp #fashion'
- YouTube: 'Watch our new collection showcase video now live on our channel.'
- Threads: 'New collection just dropped. What do you think?'
Bottom: a note 'Each variant respects platform tone, length, and hashtag conventions.' Bottom-right: '06 / 15'. Speaker notes: This is the killer feature — one post becomes 7 AI-optimized variants.

slides.title: Plan Limits & Pricing
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Plans & Limits' (gold text, 42px). Subtitle: 'How many accounts and pages you can manage.' Three pricing cards side by side. The middle card (Growth) has a gold border + 'Most Popular' badge.

Card 1 — Starter ($299/mo):
- 3 social accounts
- 1 user
- AI composer (100/mo)
- Basic analytics
- Email support

Card 2 — Growth ($499/mo) [FEATURED, gold border, glow]:
- 15 social accounts
- 5 users
- Unlimited AI composer
- Advanced analytics
- Account protection
- Priority support

Card 3 — Enterprise (Custom):
- Unlimited accounts
- Unlimited users
- Custom domain mail server
- SSO + SAML
- Dedicated success manager
- 99.9% SLA

Below the cards, add a note: 'Each plan supports cross-posting to all 7 platforms. Select up to your plan\'s account limit per post.' Bottom-right: '07 / 15'. Speaker notes: Walk through the pricing tiers — Starter for solo creators, Growth for teams, Enterprise for large orgs.

slides.title: Multi-Workspace Architecture
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Isolated databases. Zero data mixing.' (white, 36px). Subtitle: 'Every client gets their own dedicated Neon PostgreSQL database.' Create a visual architecture diagram using CSS:

Top: a central card labeled 'Main Database' with sub-text 'Customer registry · Auth · Audit log'. Gold border.

Below: three arrows pointing down (use Material icon 'south' or CSS borders) to three separate cards side by side:
- 'Tenant DB — Client A' (border: emerald)
- 'Tenant DB — Client B' (border: blue)
- 'Tenant DB — Client C' (border: violet)

Each tenant card lists: 'Posts · Accounts · Media · Comments · Analytics'.

Below: a note in gold text: 'Each client\'s data lives in a completely separate database — your data never mixes with anyone else\'s.'

Bottom-right: '08 / 15'. Speaker notes: Emphasize the enterprise-grade isolation — each client gets their own database.

slides.title: AI Composer
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'AI writes the right caption for every platform.' (gold text, 36px). Subtitle: 'Same brief. Different tone. Platform-perfect output.' Three glass cards side by side, each showing a platform + AI-generated caption:

Card 1 — Instagram (border: #E1306C):
Icon: 'photo_camera'. Caption (in a monospace-style box): 'New collection just dropped! ✨ Swipe to see the full lookbook → Which piece is your favorite? 💬 #fashion #newdrop #style'

Card 2 — LinkedIn (border: #0A66C2):
Icon: 'business_center'. Caption: 'We\'re excited to launch our latest collection — a result of months of research into what modern professionals need. Explore the full range on our website.'

Card 3 — X/Twitter (border: #1DA1F2):
Icon: 'chat'. Caption: 'New drop just landed. 7 pieces. 1 collection. 0 compromises. Shop now → #fashion'

Below: 'The AI respects each platform\'s character limit, tone, and hashtag conventions.' Bottom-right: '09 / 15'. Speaker notes: Show how the same brief becomes 3 completely different captions optimized per platform.

slides.title: Account Safety
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Your accounts are protected.' (gold text, 42px). Subtitle: 'Anti-suspension guards built into every publish.' Left side: large Material icon 'verified_user' (emerald color, 120px) with a subtle glow. Right side: 4 feature cards in a 2x2 grid:
1. Icon: 'speed' — Cadence Monitoring — 'Blocks posts that exceed platform rate limits'
2. Icon: 'block' — Hashtag Blocking — 'Flags banned hashtags before you publish'
3. Icon: 'schedule' — Smart Cooldowns — 'Enforces safe intervals between posts'
4. Icon: 'warning' — Risk Flags — 'Alerts on content patterns that trigger suspensions'
Bottom-right: '10 / 15'. Speaker notes: Emphasize that SYNQUE actively prevents account suspensions — not just reactive but proactive.

slides.title: Security & Compliance
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Enterprise-grade security.' (gold text, 42px). Subtitle: 'Your data is protected at every layer.' 8 security badge cards in a 4x2 grid. Each card: Material icon (emerald) + label + 1-line detail:
1. 'lock' — AES-256 Encryption — 'All sensitive data encrypted at rest'
2. 'key' — bcrypt + JWT — 'Password hashing (cost 12) + token auth'
3. 'fingerprint' — Biometric Auth — 'Face ID / Fingerprint via WebAuthn'
4. 'shield' — 2FA / TOTP — 'Two-factor authentication support'
5. 'speed' — Rate Limiting — 'Auth, AI, and write endpoints throttled'
6. 'history' — Audit Logging — 'Every security event tracked'
7. 'security' — CSP + Headers — 'Strict Content-Security-Policy'
8. 'domain' — Tenant Isolation — 'Per-client isolated databases'
Below: a pill that says 'SOC2-Ready'. Bottom-right: '11 / 15'. Speaker notes: Walk through the security layers — encryption, auth, rate limiting, audit, isolation.

slides.title: Team Collaboration
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Built for teams.' (gold text, 42px). Subtitle: 'Roles, approvals, and accountability — without the chaos.' Top section: 5 role pills in a row (use accent-pill style):
- Owner (gold border)
- Admin (gold border)
- Manager (blue border)
- Editor (emerald border)
- Viewer (muted border)

Below: an approval workflow diagram using 4 cards with arrows between them:
1. 'Draft Created' (icon: 'edit_note') → 2. 'Submitted for Review' (icon: 'rate_review') → 3. 'Approved / Rejected' (icon: 'check_circle') → 4. 'Published' (icon: 'rocket_launch')

Use Material icon 'arrow_forward' between cards.

Bottom note: 'Every action is logged. Every team member sees what they need to.' Bottom-right: '12 / 15'. Speaker notes: Explain the role hierarchy and the approval workflow — drafts go through review before publishing.

slides.title: Analytics & Reports
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Measure what matters.' (gold text, 42px). Subtitle: 'Cross-platform analytics + custom report builder.' Three chart preview cards side by side (use CSS to simulate charts — do NOT use real chart libraries):

Card 1 — 'Followers Growth' (icon: 'trending_up'):
Draw a simple area-chart shape using CSS gradients/clips. Label: '88.7K followers · +4.2% this week'

Card 2 — 'Platform Distribution' (icon: 'pie_chart'):
Draw a simple pie-chart using CSS conic-gradient. Label: '7 platforms connected'

Card 3 — 'Engagement' (icon: 'favorite'):
Draw simple bar shapes using CSS divs. Label: '48.2K total engagement · +12% MoM'

Below: 'Export custom reports as PDF. Schedule weekly digests. Share with stakeholders.' Bottom-right: '13 / 15'. Speaker notes: Show the analytics capabilities — followers, engagement, platform distribution, custom reports.

slides.title: Pricing
slides.task_brief:
Title: 'Start with a 15-day free trial.' (gold text, 42px). Subtitle: 'No card to explore. Pick a plan when you\'re ready.' Three pricing cards:

Card 1 — Starter:
'$299' (large, gold) + '/mo' (muted)
'For solo creators & small teams'
3 social accounts · 1 user · AI composer (100/mo)
Button: 'Start trial' (outline style)

Card 2 — Growth [FEATURED, gold border + glow + 'Most Popular' badge]:
'$499' (large, gold) + '/mo' (muted)
'For growing teams that publish daily'
15 social accounts · 5 users · Unlimited AI
Button: 'Start trial' (gold filled)

Card 3 — Enterprise:
'Custom' (large, gold)
'For large teams with custom needs'
Unlimited everything · SSO + SAML · 99.9% SLA
Button: 'Contact sales' (outline style)

Below all cards: 'All plans include the AI composer, account protection, and real-time analytics.' (muted, centered).
Bottom-right: '14 / 15'. Speaker notes: Present the three tiers and encourage starting with the 15-day free trial.

slides.title: Get Started
slides.task_brief: Closing slide. Center-aligned. Large title: 'Start your 15-day free trial' (gold gradient text, 56px). Subtitle: 'Full access to every module. No card to explore. Cancel anytime.' (white, 20px). Below: a large gold button (gold background, dark text, rounded-xl, padding 16px 48px) that says 'Get Started →'. Below the button: 'Or visit synque.vercel.app to learn more' (muted, 14px). Add a subtle radial gold glow behind the title. Bottom-left brand mark: 'SYNQUE'. Bottom-right: '15 / 15'. Speaker notes: Close with a strong call to action — invite the audience to start their free trial today.
